clues: This small town sits in the Northern Cape province. It lies in the dry north of South Africa.
Its river stays dry for most of the year. After heavy rain, flash floods rush down it at once.
It began in 1821 as a mission station. Robert Moffat set it up for a London mission group.
David Livingstone came to this town in 1841. It was his first post as a missionary.
Deep water rises here at a spring called the Eye. That rare spring is the mark this town is known by.
